definition_zh: 通过卷积操作从输入数据中学习特征的神经网络。
scope_note: 一维卷积神经网络属于卷积神经网络；一维限定及全卷积等网络结构限定分别保留。
usage_overview: 在基于响应数据识别高速铁路轮轨力的混合网络中，承担特征提取与降维任务，从输入响应中提取抽象特征并压缩特征维度。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: Recently, the convolutional neural network (CNN) [22], a type of neural networks in deep learning [23], has gained growing attention in structural damage detection.
Abdeljaber et al. [27] presented an accurate and fast detection system by means of the CNN to achieve acceleration-based damage detection and localisation.
